dog.description_text:
Meet Spud! This Great Pyrenees mix is a wonderful combination of playful puppy and a calm, easygoing demeanor. He’s eager, very smart, and great on walks, where he already walks nicely on a loose leash. Spud is also social with other dogs, happily hanging out with them and giving them kisses. At home, he’s making fast progress with both house training and crate-training.

Spud is an overall angel who is ready to keep growing with his forever family. He’s a smart boy and has all the makings of a wonderful companion!

Registered adopters interested in Spud can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
